source: Ed4 J.4.1.2, pp.J-7 to J-8; C.4.15, Table C-3, p.C-55
description: WARNINGs about a type 13 D_PDU, overheard between other nodes, are reported: reason 4 as a node that can run only P2P or CSMA, reason 3 as a node in a different MAC mode from the node it warned; a repeat is not reported again.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 2000 a burst with three WARNING D_PDUs to 0.0.1.3, address size 4, EOW 0, EOT 10: from 0.0.1.9 RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 13 reason 4; from 0.0.1.7 RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 13 reason 3; from 0.0.1.9 again the same as its first. They are addressed to another node, so no state machine acts on them (C-0566), but the analysis reads them (J-0043, J-0044, J-0083). A WARNING about type 13 with reason 0 or 4 says its sender does not know the WTRP types and can run only P2P or CSMA, presumably a legacy node (J-0047, J-0048, J-0050); one with reason 3 says its sender runs a different MAC mode from the node it warned (J-0049, J-0050). At the burst end 3000, WARNING findings in byte order: finding 3 for 0.0.1.9, addressee 0.0.1.3, then finding 4 for 0.0.1.7, addressee 0.0.1.3; the third WARNING repeats the finding last reported for 0.0.1.9 and is not reported (J-0082). Report: S_MANAGEMENT_MSG_INDICATION (type 19) to every bound client, MSG TYPE 1, 9-byte MSG BODY: finding code, the node (4 bytes), the addressee of the WARNING behind it (4 bytes, all zero when none), each address in the S_primitive address format, SIZE 7, individual (Fig S-19; J-0082). At 10000 another burst with the same WARNING from 0.0.1.9 (EOT 2): again a repeat, nothing reported. Nothing is queued, so the MAC starts no timer (K-0096).
